## Separate offline browser companion — pre-implementation reservation

Contributor `chatgpt:5f566b5ec8ef:mac_continuity` takes a new, isolated **backup → inspect every order → explicitly select eligible reminders → preview → download ICS** browser companion. The accepted #45 CLI/model and its receiving remain unchanged and attributed to estate-9c989aece9a2. This is not a takeover of source adoption, the tracker, or any existing browser restoration/calendar control.

The concrete recipient gap is command-free use of an exported backup without restoring it into browser storage. I read the full accepted seven-file joined source closure `e92e2545`, five-path offer `2f3096c6`, root acceptance `382b10e5`, this issue and all current comments. The existing #45 source fence is the new CLI/model/test/guide; no companion browser source or owner was found in the bounded current issue search. The direct scalar native coordination screen covered 1,145 records, with access refusals retained; that is advisory coverage, not an exclusive native lease.

**Source fence:** only a new private browser-companion namespace (model/controller/template/builder/tests/guide/evidence). Bundle exact unchanged `backup.ts`, `calendar-batch.ts`, `ics.ts`, `deadline.ts`, `completion.ts` from the accepted joined closure, preserving all original inputs and using the native serializer. The accepted CLI model is only an unchanged parity reference. No existing tracker, store, CLI, dependency, workflow or README edit. #8/#10/#20 adoption, #19 calendar, #30 completion, #34 end-date, #40 reminder time, #41 enquiry, #44 comparison and #45 original ownership remain intact.

Frozen before candidate: `D:/HAMON/returnby-backup-calendar-browser-5f566b5ec8ef/CONTRACT.json`, SHA256 `6bd1aed6f2ba464333cc1398a4117c5fdc201f4bc43735679aa225027fc8b403`. Explicit file only, strict full UTF-8/v1/v2 admission; all records visible in source order, completed/blocked unselectable; no default selection. Preserve native 5MiB/2,000-total-record/4MiB limits, sorting, UID, escaping, dates and three-day alarm. Capture one review timestamp per admitted file; preview/download binds exact bytes, hash, selected IDs and native result. New file/selection/Clear retires stale reads/hashes/previews, including A→B→A. No restore, browser storage, network, provider/calendar import, inference of current retailer policy or promise of cross-timezone invariance.

Actual Node24/Chrome receiving will cover the **new** browser boundary, physical ICS parity and late-request retirement; original #45 campaigns are not repeated or relabeled. Existing esbuild is available on admitted MSI; no installation or new hosting. No product source exists yet.

Fresh main is `1e662c387be5f66f8499fac7ec443f58d2198379`. I read the complete 54-leaf tree and both full workflows (`b5688812`, `a0b5ed32`): PR/main-push only, no issue/comment trigger. This metadata creates no ref, PR, Actions, main change or DB append. Conscience remains not_attempted under the standing storage hold. If an existing unreported browser-companion allocation intersects this precise new namespace, please identify its exact source/receiving fence here; implementation will preserve that owner.
